title: Hearty Holiday Turkish Cranberry Menemen
description: A festive and floral Turkish dish featuring cranberry and bonito shave, perfect for the holiday season, this low-calorie menemen is a delicious and healthy breakfast option.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork until the whites and yolks are fully incorporated.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat until it starts to shimmer.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced red bell pepper to the skillet and cook until it is tender.
Add the cranberries to the skillet and cook until they start to pop and release their juice.
Pour the whisked eggs over the cranberry mixture in the skillet and scramble them until they are almost set.
Sprinkle the bonito flakes over the top of the eggs and fold them in gently.
Season the menemen with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the menemen to a serving platter and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
